items.statement_scope: Whole original universal hyperfield question: does 0 in x boxplus y boxplus z imply 0 in x^3 boxplus y^3 boxplus z^3 boxplus -xyz boxplus -xyz boxplus -xyz? Author Proposition19 answers no by a countable hyperfield counterexample built via fusion and fission closure of a tract.

source_caveats: Byline is exactly T. Le and C. Lowen; official original/KEY.md row5 expands the contributor names as Tuong Le and Chayim Lowen.

Counterexample is non-explicit and infinite, as authors say in the appendix. All fusion-forest diagrams are retained in the complete PDF. The appendix reports an author C++ finite search (size<=13), but the counterexample proof uses Proposition11/Theorems8/17, not that computation.
Single material-coverage reading, no independent stepwise proof certification. Proof/context page lists refer to author_pdf; statement_pages refers to separate statement_path.
